title: First deposit
description: Add money over UPI after account setup: amount, UPI app, confirmation, receipt or failure.

screens.name: Add money
screens.note: First deposit, ₹1,000 typed. One big amount on the app keypad (L3 has none, drawn locally); "+" chips add to it. Perks only on the first deposit. Groww-style layout, not the busy live screen.

screens.name: Add money · empty
screens.note: Nothing typed: amount in grey, limits under it, the button is off.

screens.name: Add money · below minimum
screens.note: ₹50: the line under the amount turns red ("Minimum ₹100"), the button is off.

screens.name: Add money · above maximum
screens.note: ₹6,00,000: red "Maximum ₹5,00,000 via UPI. Use net banking for more", the button is off.

screens.name: Add money · from the wallet
screens.note: Opened by Deposit on the INR wallet: no first-deposit perks, ₹1,100.00 available; after the receipt, Done goes back to the wallet.

screens.name: Add money · no bank account
screens.note: No bank linked (User status → Bank accounts: None): the bank row and the button ask to add one first → Add bank account.

screens.name: Add money · change bank
screens.note: The bank row (chevron) opens "Pay from": the linked banks as radio rows, picking one closes it; "Add another bank account" → Add bank account.

screens.name: Add bank account
screens.note: From the bank row or "Pay from" — the ₹ and the US add money both come here. Verify (₹1 name check) goes back to the add money it came from.

screens.name: Approve in UPI app (external)
screens.note: Handoff placeholder: the UPI app’s own payment sheet is not built by Lemonn.

screens.name: Money added
screens.note: First deposit: Start investing → the Stocks home. Opened from the wallet: Done → the wallet. (The prototype remembers the entry; a screen opened straight from the list assumes the first deposit.)

screens.name: Payment failed
screens.note: Not in the live screenshots — the failure state the flow needs. Change payment method returns to the Add money screen it came from.
